sources.quote:
Game looks interesting, and gameplay overall is good albeit a bit.. shallow. At least at this demo stage. But my god the traces of AI are disgusting, please don't let it ruin your game!
Gray View Profile View Posts 2 Oct 21 @ 1:45pm Report this post Whole game is basically AI, with thousands of independent Touhou content artists out there, there's no real need for AI. Like, I get it if you needed a placeholder, but now that the dev has a working demo, maybe it's time to hire some small artists? Last edited by Gray ; Oct 21 @ 1:45pm #1
EskiNott View Profile View Posts [developer] 1 Oct 25 @ 1:25am Report this post I'm developing this game entirely on my own, and unfortunately, my financial situation isn't great. I simply can't afford to commission artists or purchase more professional art assets. Using AI-generated artwork was a compromise I had to make due to these limitations, rather than something I would have chosen under ideal circumstances. #2

楚祺 View Profile View Posts Oct 27 @ 11:08am Report this post I really don't understand this. First of all, this game has been carefully crafted. The developer loves Touhou and wants to bring more exciting gameplay to this IP. Even though AI was used, it's not some cheaply slapped-together, low-quality cash grab; he has put a lot of hard work into it. Nitpicking about the AI is completely meaningless. Not every game has a well-known team or publisher behind it, and not every game has sufficient funding. The developer is a solo creator who managed to complete all of this entirely on his own, which is already quite admirable. Moreover, his financial situation is poor, and he can't afford to hire an art team. Using AI was not a wrong decision. We should encourage and support him. And if the game sells well later on, he will definitely change this situation. Touhou should be an inclusive IP, shouldn't it? #10

sources.quote:
While I am not pleased entirely with the AI art usage, I do understand the circumstances. As a beginner artist myself, I am slightly disappointed in that that, since there are some elements, particularly CGs, which I found really good looking, beautiful even . Were different AI models used for the art production? Because I particularly found strange that the art is very presentable and it does not at least at first glance anyway, have the usual trappings of AI image generation. I had been enjoying the game, so I am not here to throw unnecessary hate, I just want more information in regards to this. Though it is obvious, thanks to elements being different in artstyle visually, AI was used. I am rather critical of this, no matter the game, because visual incohesion is something I am able to notice and in some cases, it can actually hinder my enjoyment of a particular title. I also had seen the comments and I think it is admirable that the dev is going to work on their artistic skills so they can avod this in the future. Again, as someone who is learning how to draw, I am in full support of this decision. Thank you very much for the answer! P.S. I got this game as soon as it released, thank you for such an amazing game! It is hard for me to put down!
EskiNott View Profile View Posts [developer] Oct 27 @ 10:58am Report this post No, all the artwork was created using the same AI model. However, since the development period was quite long and I’m still a beginner in this area, my art workflow changed significantly throughout development. That’s why some assets have noticeable differences in art style. Thank you so much for your understanding and support! I really appreciate it! #1
